note: Layout law, 1080x1920. The coordinate table for templates/overlay.html, carried over from video 01. The CSS in the template draws these boxes; this file is the table to frame footage against. `y` is the law. `drawn` is what the template measured on Oct 6 2026, where it differs: the call card runs 7px past its band and a four-row trip sheet runs 17px past.

safe.note: Keep text inside x60-1020 and above y1620. From mid-frame down, the right edge (x900-1080) belongs to the platform's buttons.

cover.note: Full frame. Holds 1.6 s, then a hard cut on the second ring.

tag.note: DEMO SCENARIO. On screen from the first frame to the last.

callCard.note: Status, call clock, business name, live waveform.

caption.note: Speaker label, then up to four lines. If a caption runs past y800, cut words, not size.

subject.note: The b-roll subject band. Frame or crop every shot to put the subject here. Only the callout enters it.

tripSheet.note: Header plus four rows of 75px. Stops at x900, clear of the right-side buttons.

endCard.note: BOOKED. y560-810, line 1 y890, line 2 y1140, line 3 y1214, DEMO SCENARIO y1300, lockup y1400-1478.
